STEP 6 - Grams: whole grapes are dense, about 1.0 g/ml per piece. That gives about 5 g each, or 110 g. These look like small to medium grapes, so I will use about 4.5 g each, about 100 g in total.

STEP 7 - Energy: grapes are about 69 kcal/100 g, so 100 g gives about 69 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: 22 grapes at about 4-5 g each is plausible, roughly 100 g and 70 kcal.
